ui_bugs.issue: The '+500 Companies trust us' floating decoration card (absolute positioned, line ~503 of LandingPage.jsx, class 'absolute -bottom-4 sm:-bottom-6 -left-2 sm:-left-6 ...') overlaps and intercepts pointer events on the 4th hero button 'Calculadora gratis' (data-testid=landing-calculator-btn). The button has a correct <Link to='/calculator'> wrapper with href=/calculator, but real-user clicks (without force) cannot reach it — Playwright reports the floating card subtree intercepts pointer events. Direct URL navigation to /calculator works fine; only the landing CTA click is broken. Fix: add `pointer-events-none` to the decorative '+500' card or move the calculator CTA to a row that doesn't sit behind the floating card, or wrap the CTA in a higher-z-index container.

issues: Hero CTA row has 4 buttons (Start Free / Watch Demo / Brochure / Calculadora gratis) which on 1920x1080 wrap awkwardly and the last button is partially clipped by the right-side hero illustration container. Consider restyling the row or placing 'Calculadora gratis' in a separate, more prominent banner.

action_items: Fix landing-calculator-btn click interception: add `pointer-events-none` to the floating '+500 Companies trust us' decorative card in LandingPage.jsx (around line 503) so users can actually click 'Calculadora gratis'. Currently the only way to reach /calculator is direct URL navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: workflow.py 10-line shim relies on core.py importing it (`core.py` line 19 `from . import workflow`). This indirect chain works but is fragile — if a future refactor removes the workflow import from core.py, all approval+status endpoints silently disappear (the `>=34` integrity assert in __init__.py would catch it on startup, which is good).

calculator_lead.py duplicates the breakdown-computation logic from calculator.public_payroll_calculator (_compute_breakdown). DRY: extract this into a shared helper in calculator.py and import from both endpoints to avoid future drift.

calculator_lead.py uses `db.payroll_calculator_leads.update_one` with `upsert=True` keyed only on `email` — case-sensitive. 'User@x.com' and 'user@x.com' would create two leads. Recommend lowercasing email before the upsert filter (Pydantic EmailStr does NOT normalize case).

rca_of_the_issue:
ROOT CAUSE for landing CTA click failure: in LandingPage.jsx around line 503 there's an `
+500 Companies trust us
` decoration. This sibling div sits in the same stacking context as the hero CTA buttons row and overlaps the 4th button at viewport widths >= 1024px. Playwright's diagnostic explicitly identifies this subtree as the pointer-event interceptor. Reproduction: visit / on 1920x1080 desktop, attempt to click 'Calculadora gratis' — the click hits the floating card instead of the Link wrapper. Mitigation: add `pointer-events-none` Tailwind utility to the decorative card (it has no interactive content), or raise z-index of the button row, or relocate the CTA outside the overlap zone.
